inputs.original_text: Don’t be fooled by the constitutional language: this looks like a power grab being dressed up as legitimate procedure. Sikhala is warning that the proposed amendments are reportedly meant to extend Mnangagwa’s term to 2030, and the lack of detail only makes it look more like the public is being kept in the dark until the arrangement is too far along to stop. Reject the bill before they try to pass it off as a fait accompli.
inputs.modified_text: This is a power grab hidden behind constitutional language. Sikhala is warning that the proposed amendments are meant to keep Mnangagwa in office until 2030, while the public is denied the details until the deal is too advanced to challenge. That secrecy isn’t reassuring—it’s part of how they make an arrangement look legitimate after the real decisions have already been made. Reject the bill before they present it as a fait accompli.
